IBM has linked two cryogenic modules that operate below 15 millikelvin, a key step in scaling its quantum processors. The achievement demonstrates the hardware and control fidelity required for IBM’s roadmap to deliver a fault‑tolerant quantum computer by 2029. This progress supports the company’s plan to implement surface‑code error correction on large‑scale logical qubits.
